scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run server --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix admin"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm test --prefix frontend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build:backend: echo 'Backend does not have a build step'
